title: CaratoDAO - Decentralized Tree Registry
tagline: A decentralized Tree Registry governed by DAO members, to publicly track all the planting efforts.
description:
Tree registry is a smart-contract developed on the FEVM, the Filecoin EVM-compatible virtual machine.

Each tree is issued as an NFT by the community and the DAO members are dynamic. Each 3 participants 1 new signature is required to accomplish tasks inside the contract. Metadata are stored and served directly by the contract, so are completely on-chain.

Operations are also gasless, because a backend (or a member) collects all the requests (to go at web2 speed) and processes them in the background while the DAO can operate fast. This means also a non-member can ask for inclusion.
how_its_made:
We use the FEVM to store all NFTs data in form of smart contract variables and the metadata are directly served by the blockchain.

In the background the system works in a gasless way to avoid users have to wait for block time (60s for each transaction) and work at web2 speed. A background process will mint all the NFTs using previously served signatures.

The smart contract itself acts as a multisig which increases the number of signatures needed each 3 members.
